long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without asking still bother me, so I will read about them before I touch anything.
The clay bank gives clay I can carry home, and my paws are empty for it.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object at the workbench, and I mean to keep it.
Something I planted may be growing, and I will check it when nobody is watching.
The sunny rock catches the morning light first, and I will claim it on record.
I will sit up high and listen to the birds, which are the one sound I like.

today.reason: I will learn about seeds, make one clay object at the workbench, check my plants and then sit high where I can see the sky.
